goal: Operators can receive Kuaidi100 subscription, query, and verified callback updates through recoverable workers.
non_goals: Do not integrate Xianyu shipment or implement production UI.
Do not use real Kuaidi100 network calls in tests or default runtime.
expected_evidence: MockWebServer subscription, query, and callback fixtures
Lease, retry, throttle, duplicate, and crash-recovery tests
Task report, spec review, and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Do not assume callback delivery order or uniqueness.
Do not assume any Provider feature is enabled by configuration presence.
stop_condition: Stop if official Provider behavior is unclear, a network call enters a transaction, or tests require real credentials.
